data.narrative:
Periodic Labs is a Seed-stage AI & Software company founded by Liam Fedus and Ekin Dogus Cubuk, which has raised $300M to date. The comparable universe consists of one public company (Palantir, ticker PLTR) and eight private peers including Figure AI, Scale AI, Reflection AI, and Applied Intuition operating in the AI & Software sector.

Valuation analysis relies on a single applicable method due to data constraints. The Stage-Progression approach uses the $300M total raised as a proxy base value and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression, yielding $750M. A peer-median triangulation was not feasible: while 12 same-sector comparables exist, the narrow filters for stage, adjacency, and valuation tier returned insufficient datapoints (fewer than three required), making sector-wide median unreliable without introducing material bias.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $638M to $862M, with a median point estimate of $750M. This range reflects ±15% sensitivity around the single method result. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 2.5x stage multiplier for this particular capital structure and market moment, the absence of direct Seed-stage AI peers for validation, and limited visibility into Periodic Labs' current revenue or burn metrics. A second method, once sufficient comparable data accumulates, would substantially strengthen conviction in this range.
